scope: CPU texture encoding/compression only; Room/Gallery opt-in material release. About is approved and excluded.
sourceEncoding: Unchanged RGBM32 linear diffuse + emission bakes

webEncoding.compression: UASTC + Zstd9; full explicit mip chain
webEncoding.fallback: Permanent <state>-<slot>.logrgb.png, same base-level representation as KTX input
webEncoding.mipMethod: Decode original RGBM32, BOX-filter floating linear radiance, then LogRGB-encode every level including level0.

diagnosis: UASTC quantized the RGBM alpha multiplier to zero in many 4x4 blocks; the raw RGBM PNG did not contain these black blocks. Constant-alpha LogRGB avoids the multiplier collapse.

limitations: ASTC/BC7 GPU decoding and browser appearance require separate WebGL validation.
LogRGB hardware bilinear interpolation is an approximation in encoded space; every authored mip is generated in linear radiance.
Low-resolution sparse UV islands and strong contrast retain lossy block-compression error; alpha1 removes RGBM multiplier collapse, not all quantization.
syntheticCompressedAudit.temporaryArtifactLifetime: Generated inside TemporaryDirectory and removed after successful assertions.
